field.text:
Vasiel has been blessed by Milani because of actions he took to aid a group of half elves. They had banded together for protection and were being persecuted by local townsfolk. He left to live in Varisia because of the aftermath of this event.
Spent decades studying varisian history and ancient Thassilon. Now he is the Guest Lecturer of Thassilonian Grammar at the Acadamae in Korvosa. Has grown disenfranchised with the pure theory work when he began to doubt the validity of many of the sources as they were third hand or worse. Took a refresher Conjuration course but designed a self corriculum based on the Thassilonian School of Sloth allowed him to combine his interests. Joined an expedition to investigate some recently unearthed Thasillonian ruins. Took ill on the journey there and was left in Sandpoint to recover. Has now recovered but has no way to catch up with the caravan.

field.text:
Did some festival activities, met some people. Fought some goblins, it got hairy. Missed all my acid darts, slept 3 gobbos. The excitement of battle again! Father Zandros healed and thanked us afterwards. Saved a racist noble, Foxglove.
Foxglove wants a boar hunt. Father Zandros wants help with a graveyard theft. Cerdac (Actor) wants us to attend the theatre.
Went to graveyard. Previous priest's remains were stolen. Necromancy at foot.
Went to theatre.

Goblins -- Tribes - Bird Crunchers: Mountain.s Keep to themselves. Lick Toad: Marsh. Swim. Seven Tooth: Shanks wood. Raid the junkyard. Tinkerers. Mosswood: Biggest tribe. Fight amongst themselves. Thistletop: Nettle wood.
Big Nobs: ?: Big goblin, mosswood. Koruvus: Magical Longsword, oversized. Vorka: Eats other goblins. Lives in the mash. Rendwater Gutwald: Fat chieften of the briarstrunk? Never gets up. Rip nugget: Thistletop. Has the best lair. Bruthalamest: Bugbear ranger. Nettlewood. Likes booze. Hates elves.

Formed the Sandpoint Volunteer Police Department (SVPD) Vasiel made everyone badges.
Abyssal prayer book of Lamashtu Found Lamashtu altar with corrupting waters. Took a sample.

Found out that Brothers of the Seven backed Vorel Foxglove to build their manor. Now that the family is extinct ownership of their manor will revert to an organisation named the Brothers of the Seven.
The Foxglove were playing someone named "B7" at Seven's Sawmill for "Aisha's Trips to Absolom".
Found out that Mr and Mrs Foxglove had been replaced by faceless stalkers, as well as their body guard.

Got drunk. Got tattooes. Got a good night's rest.
Headed to the shadow clock tower, expecting to find the cult's boss and maybe a scarecrow golem. Fought a flesh golem and it's pet rats instead.
Tried climbing a rickety staircase, had a bell thrown down at them getting badly hurt in the process. Gave up on the tower for the day. Went to the pathfinder lodge to request asylum (healing and a place to rest).
Next day, went back to the clocktower, climbed to the top from the outside wall. Fought a bunch of snakes on the top floor.

Found a note. Guiding us to "Turtleback Ferry", claiming a group had taken over Fort Raddick. Also implicated a plot to kill the mayor.
Warned the mayor. Got a reward.
Fort Raddick are garrisoned by rangers, Black Arrows. Mayor of Magnimar is not on good terms with them, but does normally receive regular reports and has not heard from them in several weeks.
The Mayor asked us to save the fort. Offerred us 750gp each to deal with it.
Went to the temple of Sarenrae and requisitioned some healing supplies.
